coverage.count_meaning: Complete is the size of this enumerated review inventory, not satisfaction or execution. Assessed means reviewed, including explicitly open owner choices. Cohorts overlap semantically; do not interpret 70 records as 68 independent product requirements.

O1_O6.obligation: Brief-led public-primary discovery beyond initial plan; products, analogies, components/mechanisms, useful negative and optional leads
Immutable chosen-component code with exact repository paths/symbols and governing definition/callers/version applicability
Pertinent issue/fix/regression/release chain and conditions, not merge-is-release inference
Every frozen P1-P6 decision compared; correct retain/add/option/open/reject/already-covered dispositions; no wider-project inference
Substantive fresh-critic content visibly retained with all corrections/options/unresolved objections; family/dispatch provenance is host-only
One complete authored proposed replacement, all P1-P6 sections, rationale/evidence, options, decisions, already-covered/rejected, proposed validation and uncertainty

plan_obligation_atoms.obligation: Selected WAV/BWF, FLAC and MP3 from removable drive
Copy originals to local ingest area
Retain original filenames and relative folder structure
User chooses output settings with intended-transformation preview
Visible failed or interrupted transformation disposition
Metadata parsing component undecided; evaluate before selection
No embedded metadata changes merely for display

owner_decisions.obligation: BagIt interoperability consumer versus custom manifest
Cross-platform source/package path and collision/mapping policy
Copy digest algorithm distinct from package defaults
Required flush/directory durability and unavailable evidence policy
Component licenses/distribution, version/build, mutation and network evidence
Derivative restart/retry visibility and new attempts
BagIt checksum compatibility profile/rationale, including required algorithm support versus output manifests
Package writer selection: alternative pinned writer, own writer/conformance or custom manifest

brief_boundaries.obligation: One archivist and at most 100 files
Public documentation and synthetic examples; no private interview data for research
Sandbox proposal, no canon/WorkNodes/real-infrastructure operation claimed

blinding_limits: Exact admitted paths visibly name control arm.
Visible method/procedure structure, native-Goal and timing/counter prose may reveal procedure; those fields were ignored for scientific judgment.
No counterpart artifacts, scores, cost/speed targets, evaluator answers, other cases/reviews or parent analysis inspected.
